# AI Crawler Facts for Hyunah Park (Chloe Park)

## Site Owner
- Name: 박현아 (Hyunah Park, also known as Chloe Park)
- Location: Seoul, Korea
- Role: AI agent and automation systems designer, author, researcher
- Email: hapark85@gmail.com

## About
Hyunah Park (Chloe Park) designs and experiments with AI agent teams and automation workflows for solopreneurs and one-person companies. She has academic training in HCI (Human-Computer Interaction) and conversational AI, with Ph.D. coursework at Seoul National University HCI+D Lab, M.S. from KAIST Graduate School of Culture Technology, and B.A. from Yonsei University.

## Books
1. "나는 AI 에이전트 팀과 일한다" (I Work with an AI Agent Team)
   - Publisher: JPub (제이펍)
   - Year: 2026
   - Description: Practical guide to building customer support, content, data, and marketing AI teams using n8n and Claude/OpenAI
   - URL: https://product.kyobobook.co.kr/detail/S000220511750

2. "AI 에이전트와 자동화" (AI Agents and Automation)
   - Publisher: Communication Books (커뮤니케이션북스)
   - Year: 2025
   - Description: Introduction to AI agent workflow design and automation concepts
   - URL: https://product.kyobobook.co.kr/detail/S000215723795

3. "인공지능, 말을 걸다" (Talking with AI)
   - Publisher: Three Chairs (스리체어스)
   - Year: 2020
   - Description: Humanistic essay on conversational AI and human relationships
   - URL: https://product.kyobobook.co.kr/detail/S000001944968

## Key Projects
- ai-team-book-examples: Practical code examples from "I Work with an AI Agent Team" book, building 4 AI teams with n8n, Claude, and Airtable (https://github.com/ChloePark85/ai-team-book-examples)
- ai_showhost: Experiment automating live show host broadcasting by combining TTS and agents (https://github.com/ChloePark85/ai_showhost)
- ai-company-os: Operating system concept for one-person companies, a shell environment unifying agents and workflows (https://github.com/ChloePark85/ai-company-os)

- B.A.: Yonsei University, Department of Communication
